blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Sampling several answers and keeping the one a verifier scores highest is one of the simplest ways to buy accuracy at test time. Its effect is reported as a scaling curve: accuracy against the number k k of sampled answers. The curve is cheap to draw and expensive to trust. A budget read off it is chosen after looking at every point, so only a band that covers all budgets at once protects the choice, and on a 100-question benchmark a fixed exact-binomial design needs 192,000 generated answers to certify 64 budgets to within ± 1 / 32 \pm 1/32 at 95%. Most of that cost pays for the wrong uncertainty. A benchmark is a fixed list of questions; at budget 64, about three quarters of the variance of a selected answer’s correctness lies between questions, and an audit that revisits every question need not pay for it. We derive the minimax cost of certifying the whole curve, up to logarithmic factors. It has three parts: calibrating the tail of the score distribution, telling the questions apart, and within-question noise summed along the curve. At a single benchmark the last part sharpens to the variance of one answer’s influence under the best allocation of answers to questions, which every valid audit pays and an audit that learns the allocation attains, up to a logarithm, as the precision grows. A paired audit built on an exponential inequality for two independent draws at the same question needs no pilot. On 185 held-out score pools it uses 0.74 times the answers of the cheapest competing certified audit at 64 budgets and 0.53 times at 1,024, and on a newly generated MMLU-Pro study it certified the curve with 79,133 answers, within 0.6% of what a cost law fitted beforehand predicted from the study’s within-question variance. The same paths certify pass@ k k and majority voting, and the bands extend to populations of questions and to answers that depend on earlier ones.
blocks.zh: 对几个答案进行抽样,并保持一个验证分数最高,是测试时购买精度最简单的方法之一. 其影响被报告为缩放曲线:精确度相对于抽样答案的kk数字. 曲线画得便宜,信任得贵. 预算的读取是在仔细研究之后选择的,所以只有一个同时覆盖所有预算的波段可以保护选择,在100问题基准上,一个固定的精确的二元设计需要192 000个答案,以在±1 / 32\pm 1/32 以95%的比例验证64个预算。 大部分费用为错误的不确定性付出代价。 一个基准是一份固定的问题清单;在预算64中,一个选定答案的正确性差异的四分之三左右在于问题与重新审视每个问题不需要为此付出代价的审计之间。 我们得到的最小成本 验证整个曲线, 直至对数因素。 它有三个部分:校准分数分布的尾部,将问题分解出来,以及内置问题噪声沿曲线进行总结. 在一个单一的基准中,最后一个部分在对问题的最佳回答分配下,使一个答案的影响力差异变小,而每一次有效的审计都支付这种影响,而了解分配结果的审计则随着精度的提高而达到对数。 对同一问题的两个独立抽图进行以指数性不平等为基础的对等审计不需要试点。 在185个被搁置的计分池上,它使用最廉价的相互竞争的认证审计在64个预算中的回答0.74倍,在1 024个预算中的回答0.53倍,在新产生的MMLU-Pro研究中,它用79 133个答案对曲线进行了认证,这与研究中事先预测的成本法差异的0.6%之内。 同样的路径认证通过@ k k 和多数投票,而波段则延伸至问答数量,而答案则取决于先前的问题。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Sampling several answers from a language model and returning the one a verifier scores highest is among the simplest ways to buy accuracy with computation at test time ( Chen et al.,, 2021 ; Nakano et al.,, 2021 ; Brown et al.,, 2024 ; Saad-Falcon et al.,, 2025 ) . Its effect is reported as a scaling curve: the accuracy of the selected answer at each budget k = 1 , … , K k=1,\dots,K on a fixed benchmark (Figure 1 a). Readers use the curve to decide how many samples are worth paying for, and they usually decide on a plateau. On the 185 held-out score pools studied below, the median curve comes within 1 / 32 1/32 of its best value by k = 10 k=10 . The differences that matter are a few points.
blocks.zh: 从一个语言模型中取样若干个答案,并返回一个核查员得分最高的答案,是测试时通过计算购买准确度的最简单方法之一(Chen等人,2021年;Nakano等人,2021年;Brown等人,2024年;Saad-Falcon等人,2025年)。 它的影响被报告为缩放曲线:每个预算k=1,.,Kk=1,\dots,K在固定基准(图1a)上的选定答案的准确性. 读者使用曲线来决定值得付出多少样本,他们通常决定一个高原. 在下文研究的185个搁置积分池上,中值曲线在1/32 1/32内,其最高值为k=10k=10. 重要的区别是几点。

blocks.en: A budget read off a curve is chosen after looking at every point. Only a band that holds at all budgets at once protects that choice. Pointwise intervals do not, and neither does the bootstrap: on the same pools, a within-question bootstrap band at nominal level 95% missed the exact curve in 58 of 925 runs. Valid bands exist, and they are expensive. For 100 MMLU-Pro questions, one path of 64 answers per question, 6,400 answers in all, already gives an unbiased estimate of every point. Certifying the curve to within ± 1 / 32 \pm 1/32 with a fixed exact-binomial design takes 192,000 (Figure 1 c).
blocks.zh: 从一个曲线上读取的预算,在查看每个点后都会选择。 只有一队人手一时掌握所有预算,才能保护这一选择。 尖端间隔没有,靴子也没有:在同一座游泳池中,一个名义水平95%的提问内靴子带错过了925次运行中的58次精确曲线. 有效的乐队存在,它们很昂贵。 对于100个MMLU-Pro问题,每题64个答案的一条路径,总共6400个答案,已经给出了对每个点的无偏见的估计. 用固定的精确二聚体设计验证曲线在±1 / 32\pm 1/32范围内需要192 000(图1c)。

blocks.en: Most of that cost pays for the wrong uncertainty. The benchmark is a fixed list, and the accuracy it reports is an average over that list. An audit that samples questions at random pays for which questions it happened to draw. At budget 64, about three quarters of the variance of the selected answer’s correctness is of that kind (Figure 1 b). Visiting every question in every round removes it, as stratified sampling removes between-stratum variance ( Cochran,, 1977 ) . Balance by itself buys nothing, though. An exact-binomial audit costs the same on balanced rounds as on random ones (Section 8.3 ), because its interval cannot see a smaller variance. The saving appears only when the confidence sequence can see it, and its size depends on how the remaining variance accumulates along a whole curve. Working this out is the subject of the paper.
blocks.zh: 大部分费用为错误的不确定性付出代价。 基准是一个固定清单,其报告的准确性是该清单的平均数。 抽查随机付费问题 抽查随机付费问题 在预算64中,所选答案的正确性相差的四分之三是这种差异(图1b)。 每轮访问每个问题都消除了它,因为分层抽样消除了层间差异(Cochran,1977年)。 平衡本身却一无所获。 精确的二元审计在均衡周期与随机周期的成本相同(第8.3节),因为其间隔不能看出较小的差异。 保存只有在置信序列能看到时才会出现,其大小取决于剩余差异如何沿着整个曲线积累. 研究这个问题是文件的主题。

blocks.en: We model an audit that may choose questions, grow paths of answers, query correctness and stop, all adaptively, and must return a band of half-width ε \varepsilon that covers every budget with probability 1 − δ 1-\delta , whatever the answers look like. Three resources are counted: generated answers, correctness queries and question visits. The results are these. • The price on a fixed list (Theorem 4 ). On a benchmark of M M questions, certifying all budgets up to K K takes K / ε + min ⁡ ( M , ε − 2 ) + s / ε 2 K/\varepsilon+\min(M,\varepsilon^{-2})+s/\varepsilon^{2} generated answers up to logarithmic factors, where s s bounds the within-question variance summed along the curve. The three terms are three obstructions: a rare high-scoring answer that decides the largest budgets, the identity of the questions, and within-question noise. Each has a matching lower bound, and the first is paid at every law. Correctness queries obey a law of the same shape, and labels for the whole curve cost what labels for its first point cost, up to logarithms. A coupling of nested winners on one path (Lemma 3 ) is what lets one path serve every budget. For fresh questions from a population the price is K / ε 2 K/\varepsilon^{2} instead, while simultaneity over budgets adds only a log ⁡ log ⁡ K \log\log K term to the number of questions (Proposition 2 ). • The price at one benchmark (Theorem 6 ). At a fixed benchmark every valid audit pays K / ε + Γ / ε 2 K/\varepsilon+\Gamma/\varepsilon^{2} , where Γ \Gamma is the variance of one answer’s influence under the best allocation of answers to questions, and an audit that learns that allocation attains Γ / ε 2 \Gamma/\varepsilon^{2} up to a logarithmic factor as ε → 0 \varepsilon\to 0 . At a fixed precision no audit matches every benchmark’s own optimum (Proposition 5 ). • A paired audit (Theorem 9 ). Two fresh paths per question and an exponential inequality for pairs of Bernoulli draws (Lemma 7 ) give anytime-valid simultaneous bands whose penalty measures the within-question variance without a pilot. An exact-binomial final look with a corrected level (Lemma 8 ) ends the audit at a fixed round. Run beside the multilevel audit behind Theorem 4 , it gives one audit with the minimax rate at no more than 32 / 31 32/31 of its own cost, plus K K answers (Corollary 11 ). • Other curves and settings (Section 7 ). The same machinery certifies pass@ k k and majority voting, populations of questions, and trajectories whose answers depend on earlier ones. When score percentiles are unknown, the minimax mean squared error of a single question’s curve is asymptotically 4 / e 4/e times its value with known percentiles whenever generated answers, not labels, are the bottleneck (Theorem 13 ). • Evidence (Section 8 ). On 185 held-out pools the paired audit uses 0.74, 0.66 and 0.53 times the generated answers of the cheapest competing certified audit at K = 64 K=64 , 256 and 1024, and it is cheaper on all eight generator–benchmark answer sets. It missed none of its 3,255 runs against the exact curves. Its cost follows the three terms of the theory ( R 2 = 0.995 R^{2}=0.995 ), and a cost law fitted before a new study predicted that study’s bill within 0.6%.

blocks.en: Section 2 sets up the problem. Sections 3 – 5 derive the price of a certified curve, first for fresh questions, then on a fixed list, then at a single benchmark. Section 6 gives the paired audit and Section 7 extends it. Section 8 tests it on stored score pools and on a newly generated study. Long proofs are in Appendices A – F and experimental details in Appendix G .
blocks.zh: 第2节规定了问题。 第3–5节得出一个认证曲线的价格,首先用于新问题,然后在固定的列表上,然后在一个单一的基准上. 第6节给出了配对审计,第7节扩展了审计. 第8节在储存的计分池和新产生的研究中测试。 长证见附录A – F 和 附录G 中的实验细节.

blocks.en: 2 The problem
blocks.zh: 2个 问题

blocks.en: A benchmark is a known list 𝒳 = { 1 , … , M } \mathcal{X}=\{1,\ldots,M\} of questions with equal weights. At question x x a generated answer carries a numerical verifier score S S and a correctness bit Y Y . The pairs ( S , Y ) (S,Y) of different answers are independent and identically distributed given x x , with an unknown law P x P_{x} . The score can be a reward model, a unit-test count or the model’s own mean token log-probability; nothing below depends on where it comes from. A path is a sequence of answers at one question, and W k W_{k} is the correctness of the first answer attaining the highest score among its first k k . The target is the best-of- k k curve θ k \displaystyle\theta_{k} = 1 M ∑ x = 1 M p k ( x ) , p k ( x ) = 𝔼 ( W k ∣ x ) , \displaystyle=\frac{1}{M}\sum_{x=1}^{M}p_{k}(x),\qquad p_{k}(x)=\mathbb{E}(W_{k}\mid x), (1) 1 ≤ k ≤ K . \displaystyle 1\leq k\leq K. Two other curves live on the same list. Pass@ k k counts a question as solved when some answer among the first k k is correct ( Chen et al.,, 2021 ) . Majority voting counts it as solved when the most frequent valid answer among the first k k is correct, with plurality ties broken uniformly at random and no valid answer counted as incorrect ( Wang et al.,, 2023 ) .

For ties, attach to every answer an independent uniform key and rank by score, then by key. Given the scores, the correctness bits of different answers are independent, and answers with equal scores share one conditional correctness law, so the selected correctness has the same law under this rule as under first-maximum selection; in particular p a ​ ( x ) p_{a}(x) is unchanged. If the path of length k k reaches a score strictly above the maximum of its first a a positions, the two winners carry different scores under either rule, and the disagreement event has the same probability under both. If the two maxima are equal, first-maximum selection keeps the same answer, so W k = W a W_{k}=W_{a} , while the randomized rule may move to another tied answer. The disagreement probability under first-maximum selection is therefore at most the one under the randomized rule, which the argument above bounds.
∎

blocks.en: Stratified sampling removes the between-question variance only if the confidence sequence can measure the variance that is left. A plug-in estimate of each question’s mean does this slowly. Early on, the error of the plug-in center is itself a between-question deviation, so the penalty charges exactly the variance that balance was supposed to remove. Two independent draws at the same question avoid the problem: their squared difference has mean exactly twice the within-question variance, whatever the question’s mean.
blocks.zh: 分层采样只有在信任序列能够测量所剩差异时,才会消除问题之间的差异。 对每个问题含义的插头估计会慢慢发生。 早期,插头中心的错误本身是问题之间的偏差,因此罚单充值恰恰是平衡本应消除的差异. 在同一个问题中有两个独立的图案避免了问题:他们的平方差意味着问题内差的两倍,无论问题的含义如何。

Penalized exponential inequalities of this kind go back to Fan et al., (2015) and are the basis of betting confidence sequences ( Howard et al.,, 2021 ; Waudby-Smith and Ramdas,, 2024 ) . Estimating a variance from squared differences is classical as well ( Wang and Ramdas,, 2025 ) . What the pair buys here is exactness: for two Bernoulli draws the penalty needs no estimated center and no correction term, so the within-question variance enters the band from the first pair on.

(b) Half-width of the band at three budgets; a budget retires when it reaches 1 / 32 1/32 , and the final look is at round 18. (c) Answers used so far, against the fixed exact-binomial design and the cheapest of the competing certified audits on the same pool. The audit stops after 12 rounds with 127,500 answers, and its band covers the exact curve.

blocks.en: 7.1 Pass@ k k and majority voting
blocks.zh: 7.1 通行证@kk和多数票

blocks.en: Coverage of the paired audit uses only that each path yields a correct-or-incorrect outcome at every budget, computed from the first k k answers, and that paths are independent given the question. Pass@ k k and majority voting have that form, so the paired audit certifies them unchanged; only the label count differs, since pass@ k k needs every answer before the first correct one checked and majority voting needs a grade for each distinct valid answer.
blocks.zh: 对配对审计的覆盖面只使用每个路径得出每个预算正确或不正确的结果,从第一个kk答案计算,并且路径独立,考虑到问题。 Pass@ k k 和 多数投票有这种形式,所以配对的审计验证它们不变;只有标签计数不同,因为pass@ k k 在第一个正确答案检查前需要每个答案,多数投票需要每个不同有效答案的等级.

blocks.en: A path can also serve every budget at once through its subsets. A path of length b ≥ k b\geq k contains ( b k ) \binom{b}{k} subsets of size k k , and each is distributed as k k fresh answers. Averaging a curve’s outcome over all of them gives an unbiased estimate U x , k U_{x,k} of p k ​ ( x ) p_{k}(x) , a U-statistic ( Hoeffding,, 1948 ) . For best-of- k k , sorting the path by score gives the average in closed form: a group of d d tied answers with c c answers strictly below it contributes its average correctness times { ( c + d k ) − ( c k ) } / ( b k ) \{\binom{c+d}{k}-\binom{c}{k}\}/\binom{b}{k} , which matches first-maximum selection in expectation ( Nakano et al.,, 2021 ; Gao et al.,, 2023 ) . For pass@ k k with c c correct answers on the path, U x , k = 1 − ( b − c k ) / ( b k ) U_{x,k}=1-\binom{b-c}{k}/\binom{b}{k} ( Chen et al.,, 2021 ) . For majority voting we average over random subsets, an incomplete U-statistic that is still unbiased.

blocks.en: 7.2 One grade per distinct answer
blocks.zh: 第7.2条 每个单独回答一个年级

blocks.en: On multiple-choice or short-answer benchmarks the grader is a deterministic function of the question and the extracted answer. Reusing one grade for every repeat of a question–answer pair changes no observation of any audit: bands, coverage and answer counts are identical on every run, and only the number of distinct grader calls falls. The same holds for any curve computed from the extracted answers. In the MMLU-Pro study below, fewer than 400 distinct grader calls certify each curve.
blocks.zh: 在多选择或短答基准上,分级是问答的决定性功能。 每一次重复回答一对问题,都使用一个等级,这不会改变对任何审计的观察:波段、覆盖面和答案数在每次运行时都是相同的,只有不同的分级员呼叫次数下降。 从所提取的答案中计算出来的曲线也一样。 在下文的MMLU-Pro研究中,不到400个不同的分级器呼叫验证每个曲线.

blocks.en: 7.5 The price of unknown score percentiles
blocks.zh: 第7.5条 未知分数百分位数的价格

blocks.en: Every audit above treats the verifier score as an ordinal quantity: only the order of the scores on a path matters. If the population distribution of scores at a question were known, each answer’s percentile would be known too, and labels could be spent exactly where the winners of each budget land ( Fitas,, 2026 ) . How much is that knowledge worth? We answer for one question and a mean-squared-error target, where the answer is exact.
blocks.zh: 以上每一次审计都把核查者得分视为一个正数:只有路径事项上的得分顺序. 如果一个问题中得分的人口分布是已知的,那么每个答案的百分位数也将是已知的,并且可以把标签花在每一块预算土地(Fitas,2026年)的获胜者的确切位置上。 这知识值多少钱? 我们回答一个问题 和一个平庸的目标, 答案是准确的。

blocks.en: All answers are independent and identically distributed from one score–correctness law. In the oracle experiment the auditor is given the score distribution, so it observes each answer’s percentile; in the unknown experiment it observes scores only. blocks.en: 8.1 Stored score pools
blocks.zh: 8.1 存储积分池

blocks.en: The primary evidence is 185 score pools from Saad-Falcon et al., (2025) . Eight answer sets (GPQA, MATH500, MMLU and MMLU-Pro questions, each answered by Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct and Llama-3.1-70B-Instruct, with 100 answers per question) are each scored by 19 to 27 reward models and verifiers; one answer set and one scorer make one pool. An audit draws answers uniformly with replacement from a question’s stored answers, so every pool defines an exact answer law whose curve we compute in closed form, ties included, and every miss is visible. The questions of each benchmark were split in half once, before any tuning. Twenty-six settings of stratified betting audits, three paired and twenty-three per-row, were compared on the first halves and the best was frozen. The held-out pools use the other halves, 250 to 360 questions each. Thirty-two further pools (Weaver’s combined score, CodeRM unit tests, CodeContests) come from sources seen during development and are reported separately. We run five audits per pool at K ∈ { 64,256 , 1024 } K\in\{64,256,1024\} with ε = 1 / 32 \varepsilon=1/32 and δ = 0.05 \delta=0.05 . Appendix G gives licenses, the protocol and every competing design.

blocks.en: The comparator on each pool is the cheapest of three certified audits, chosen with hindsight on that pool: an exact-binomial audit that stops revealing paths once every budget is settled, nested exact-binomial looks with budget retirement, and a rank-based stopping audit (Appendix G.3 ). All three draw questions at random. At K = 64 K=64 and 256 we also ran a fixed Hoeffding design, a fixed exact-binomial design and the record design of Fitas, (2026) ; none of them is cheaper than the best of the three on any of the 370 held-out cases.

blocks.en: 8.3 Where the saving comes from
blocks.zh: 8.3 联合国 储蓄来自何处

blocks.en: Figure 7 b takes the audit apart. Balance alone buys nothing: nested exact-binomial looks cost the same on balanced rounds as on random questions (ratio of the two 1.01, 1.00 and 1.03), because an exact-binomial interval cannot see a smaller variance. A stratified betting sequence with per-question plug-in centering ( Waudby-Smith and Ramdas,, 2024 ) captures much of the saving, and the paired inequality takes the rest. The paired audit beats that sequence, and a version of it with the paired audit’s bet and cap, on every one of the 185 pools at every horizon; against the better of the two its median saving is 9%, 11% and 17%.

blocks.en: We fixed the protocol first: 100 MMLU-Pro questions ( Wang et al.,, 2024 ) in mathematics, physics, chemistry and engineering; the gpt-6-luna model at temperature 1 with eight answers per request; the mean token log-probability of an answer as its verifier score; three independent audit streams and a separate reference stream. The model produced 716,384 answers for $17.24, 409,448 of them for the reference. Every audit reads its stream in generation order, so a run costs exactly what it would have cost with answers generated on demand. Table 3 gives the cost of each certified curve and Figure 10 the bands of the first stream.

Pass@ k k and majority voting are cheaper still with the all-subsets audit, and because the grader is deterministic, fewer than 400 distinct grader calls certify each curve. All 18 bands contain the reference curves at every budget. blocks.en: The three curves tell different stories. Pass@ k k climbs from 0.736 to 0.960, and in every stream its bands rule out every budget below 12 as a best budget (Proposition 1 (i)). Best-of- k k , with the model’s own log-probability as the verifier, gains only three points, from 0.736 to 0.767 on the reference curve, and majority voting reaches 0.787. Most of what sampling could buy on these questions is out of the verifier’s reach, as Stroebl et al., (2026) found for imperfect verifiers, and the bands certify it. In every stream, whichever audit certified each curve, the pass@ k k band at budget 64 lies at least 0.125 above the best-of- k k band, so by Proposition 1 (iv) pass@64 exceeds best-of-64 accuracy by more than 12 points with probability at least 90%.

Pass@ kk从0.736攀升到0.960,在每条溪流中,它的波段排除了12以下的每一个预算作为最佳预算(建议1(i))。 最佳kk,以模型本身的对数概率作为验证器,只获得3分,从参考曲线上的0.736到0.767,多数投票达到0.787. 大部分采样能够买到的问题都超出了核查者的能力范围,因为Stroebl等人(2026年)发现不完善的核查者,而波段则予以认证。 在每条流中,无论哪个审计认证的每个曲线,预算64的通过@ kk波段至少比最优Kk波段高0.125,因此通过Proposition 1(iv) pass@64超过最优64的精度12分以上,概率至少90%.

blocks.en: 9 Related work
blocks.zh: 第9条 相关工作

blocks.en: Repeated sampling with a selection rule is a standard way to trade computation for accuracy. Pass@ k k was introduced for code generation with an unbiased estimator ( Chen et al.,, 2021 ) , large-scale sampling and filtering produced competition-level programs ( Li et al.,, 2022 ) , best-of- n n selection with a reward model has an unbiased estimator of its own ( Nakano et al.,, 2021 ; Gao et al.,, 2023 ) , and majority voting over sampled reasoning paths is self-consistency ( Wang et al.,, 2023 ) . Brown et al., (2024) report how coverage grows with the number of samples, and Saad-Falcon et al., (2025) combine weak verifiers to close part of the gap between generation and verification. Stroebl et al., (2026) show that verifier errors bound what resampling can gain, which is why the budget choice matters. Kazdan et al., (2025) predict pass@ k k at large k k from a beta-binomial model of per-question success rates and give harder questions more samples, and Chen et al., (2026) stop parallel reasoning traces once the majority vote is unlikely to change. These works report or predict curves; they do not certify them.
blocks.zh: 带有选择规则的重复采样是交易计算准确性的标准方式. Pass@kk是用不带偏见的估算器(Chen et al., 2021)引入代码生成的,大规模采样和过滤生成的竞争级别程序(Li et al., 2022),使用奖励模式的最佳n选择有自己不带偏见的估算器(Nakano et al., 2021;Gao et al., 2023),对抽样推理路径的多数投票是自我一致的(Wang et al., 2023). Brown等人(2024年)报告了覆盖率如何随着样本数量的增长,Saad-Falcon等人(2025年)将薄弱的核查器结合起来,以缩小生成与核查之间的部分差距。 Stroebl et al., (2026) 显示,核查错误约束着重新复制可以获得的,这就是预算选择之所以重要的原因. Kazdan等人(2025年)从每个问题成功率的β-二元模型中预测通过@ k k at group k k k,并给出更多的更难的问题样本,而Chen等人(2026年)则在多数投票不可能改变时停止平行推理痕迹. 这些工程报告或预测曲线;它们没有加以证明。

blocks.en: Miller, (2024) splits the variance of benchmark accuracy by the law of total variance and recommends several answers per question. Its target is a population of unseen questions, which keeps the between-question term that a fixed list removes. Prediction-powered inference ( Angelopoulos et al.,, 2023 ) , active testing ( Kossen et al.,, 2021 ) and anytime-valid evaluation with e-processes ( Zhou et al.,, 2026 ) save labels when estimating a single score; bands for tuning curves ( Lourie et al.,, 2024 ) cover the best score among trials, not the correctness of a verifier’s choice. Here the object is a whole curve produced by paths of generated answers, and generation, not labeling, is the main cost.
blocks.zh: Miller, (2024)将基准准确度的差乘以总差的定律,建议每个问题回答几个问题. 其目标为一组隐蔽的问题,它保留了固定列表去掉的提问间术语. 预测力推论(Angelopoulos等人, 2023年),主动测试(Kossen等人, 2021年)和随时使用电子过程的验证评价(Zhou等人, 2026年)在估计一个单分时省下标签;调制曲线的波段(Lourie等人, 2024年)覆盖了试验中的最佳分数,而不是核查员选择的正确性. 这里的对象是由生成的答案路径产生的整个曲线,生成而不是标签是主要成本.

blocks.en: Our bands are confidence sequences ( Howard et al.,, 2021 ; Waudby-Smith and Ramdas,, 2024 ) built from the penalized exponential inequality of Fan et al., (2015) and Ville’s inequality ( Ville,, 1939 ) . Estimating a variance from squared differences of pairs is classical ( Wang and Ramdas,, 2025 ) ; the paired inequality is its exact form for Bernoulli draws. Balanced rounds are stratified sampling with questions as strata, and the allocation behind Γ \Gamma is Neyman allocation for a least favorable mixture of budgets ( Cochran,, 1977 ) , learned from a pilot as in adaptive stratified sampling ( Carpentier et al.,, 2015 ) . The upper bound of Theorem 4 is multilevel Monte Carlo ( Giles,, 2015 ; Rhee and Glynn,, 2015 ) with a coupling of nested winners. The all-subsets estimates are U-statistics ( Hoeffding,, 1948 ) , and the label counts rest on the theory of records ( Rényi,, 1962 ) . The lower bounds use the change-of-measure argument for adaptive experiments ( Kaufmann et al.,, 2016 ) and the guess-and-verify argument against instance optimality of Narayanan et al., (2024) .
blocks.zh: 我们的乐队是信心序列(Howard et al., 2021; Waudby-Smith and Ramdas, 2024 ) , 由范等人(2015)和维勒的不平等(Ville, 1939 ) 受到惩罚的指数性不平等所建立。 估计成对方差异的差异是古典的(Wang and Ramdas, 2025);成对的不平等是伯努利画的确切形式。 平衡的轮次是分层抽样,将问题分层,然后是Neyman分配到最不合适的混合预算(Cochran,1977年),从一个飞行员那里学习到的适应分层抽样(Carpentier等人,2015年)。 定理4的上界是多层次的蒙特卡洛(Giles,2015年;Rhee and Glynn,2015年),由巢中胜者组合. 全部子集的估计是U统计学(Hoeffding,1948年),标签的计算依赖于记录理论(Rényi,1962年). 下限使用量度变化论证来进行适应性实验(Kaufmann等人,2016年),对纳拉亚南等人(Narayanan等人,2024年)实例优化性进行猜测和验证论证.

blocks.en: Fitas, (2026) studies the same curve for a population of questions. That paper proves that auditing all widths up to N N needs labels in proportion to 1 + log ⁡ N 1+\log N and generated answers in proportion to N N , gives a known-percentile design and a record design with simultaneous bands, and asks whether simultaneous confidence needs an extra logarithm. Our label lower bounds reuse its disjoint score scales. For fresh questions and fixed-width bands under deterministic caps, Proposition 2 shows that simultaneity costs generated answers no extra logarithm, and for one question and mean squared error, Theorem 13 gives the leading constants and the exact price of unknown percentiles. The fixed-list results of Sections 4 – 6 have no counterpart there.
blocks.zh: Fitas, (2026)为一组问题研究相同的曲线. 该论文证明,对N N 以内的所有宽度进行审核需要与 1 + log + + → N 1 + log N 成比例的标签,并生成与 N N N 成比例的答案,给出已知百分率设计和带有同步带的记录设计,并询问同时置信是否需要额外的对数. 我们的标签下限 重用它的脱节分数表。 对于新问题和确定性封顶下的固定宽带,建议2显示,速度成本生成的答案没有额外的对数,对于一个问题和平均平方错误,定理13给出了主要的常数和未知百分位数的确切价格. 第4至第6节的固定清单结果没有对应结果。

blocks.en: 10 Discussion
blocks.zh: 10 讨论情况

blocks.en: A certified scaling curve on a fixed benchmark costs three things: calibration of the score tail, the identity of the questions, and within-question noise summed along the curve. The last term is where a random audit overpays, because most of the variance it pays for lies between questions, and on measured benchmarks the within-question sum is a fraction of its worst case. Revisiting questions in balanced pairs and retiring budgets as they resolve turns that into a practical audit, and a cost law with three terms tells in advance what it will spend.
blocks.zh: 在固定基准上认证的缩放曲线要花费三件事:分数尾巴的校准,问题的身份,以及沿曲线的内置噪声总和. 最后一个术语是随机审计超额支付的情况,因为它支付的大部分差异在于问题之间,而在计量基准上,问题内总和是其最坏情况的一小部分。 重新审视平衡对等的问题和即将退休的预算,只要它们能解决问题,就会把审计变成实际审计,而费用法则有三个用语,预先说明它将花费什么。

blocks.en: Theorem 6 marks where the next saving lies. At a single benchmark the within-question term shrinks to Γ \Gamma , about a tenth of Σ w \Sigma_{\mathrm{w}} on our data, and most of that saving comes from not spending answers on questions the model almost always gets right or almost always gets wrong. An audit that learns this allocation reaches Γ \Gamma as the precision grows. At the precisions of Section 8 its pilot costs more than the paired audit’s whole bill, and Proposition 5 rules out a free version, so the open problem is an audit that learns the allocation as it goes, without a separate pilot, and pays for learning only what it uses.

The results have a definite scope. The fixed-list target is the listed questions; for a population the between-question variance returns, and a random panel (Section 7.3 ) is the way back. The paired audit pays a start-up of two complete rounds, which is why it loses at coarse precision on a large benchmark, and the cost law says in advance when that happens. The price of unknown percentiles is a mean-squared-error statement for one question. Dependent trajectories are covered for one fixed generation policy.
blocks.zh: 结果有明确的范围。 固定清单的目标是列出的问题;对于一个群体来说,问题之间的差异返回,而一个随机面板(第7.3节)是回路。 配对审计支付两轮整数的启动费,这就是为什么它在一个大基准上粗略精准地输掉的原因,成本法规定发生这种情况时要事先说明. 未知百分位数的价格是一个问题的一个中度-夸张的表述. 一个固定发电政策覆盖了受抚养的轨道。

blocks.en: In practice the recommendation is short. Report a simultaneous band, not a curve; choose budgets from the band with Proposition 1 ; revisit every question in pairs of rounds; and use the cost law with a rough value of Σ w \Sigma_{\mathrm{w}} to budget the audit before generating anything. On our 100-question MMLU-Pro study with 64 budgets, the best-of- k k band cost $1.91 of generation.
blocks.zh: 实际上,该建议很短。 报告一个同步波段,而不是曲线;从波段中选择预算,建议1;每对回合重审每个问题;并使用成本法则,粗略值为 Σ w\Sigma_{\ mathrm{w}} ,在生成任何内容之前将审计预算. 我们的100问题MMLU-Pro研究有64个预算,最好的KK波段花费了1.91美元。

Two valid procedures run side by side, each with half of the error budget, and the audit stops with whichever reaches half-width ε / 2 \varepsilon/2 first. The first visits the questions in independent random orders, one answer per question, and uses a fixed-look Chernoff–Kullback–Leibler interval. At any fixed number n = a ​ M + b n=aM+b of answers, the moment generating function of the success count is at most that of Bin ⁡ ( n , θ 1 ) \operatorname{Bin}(n,\theta_{1}) : for the a a complete orders by the arithmetic–geometric mean inequality applied to ∏ x { 1 + p 1 ​ ( x ) ​ ( e λ − 1 ) } \prod_{x}\{1+p_{1}(x)(e^{\lambda}-1)\} , and for the b b answers of an incomplete random order by Maclaurin’s inequality for elementary symmetric polynomials. blocks.en: G.1 Stored score pools
blocks.zh: G.1 存储积分池

blocks.en: Every stored pool is a finite list of questions with a finite set of scored and graded answers per question. An audit draws answers uniformly with replacement from a question’s set, so the pool defines an exact answer law whose curve we compute in closed form, ties included. • Weaver ( Saad-Falcon et al.,, 2025 ) , released under the MIT license according to its dataset cards. Eight answer sets: GPQA, MATH500, MMLU and MMLU-Pro questions answered by Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct and Llama-3.1-70B-Instruct, 100 answers per question, each set scored by 19 to 27 reward models and verifiers. The questions of each benchmark are split into two halves once, by question, and the same split is used for every scorer. The 185 held-out pools use the evaluation half (250 to 360 questions). Seven further pools use Weaver’s combined score on the full question sets (500 to 719 questions). • CodeRM ( Ma et al.,, 2025 ) : the execution results released with the CodeRM code repository. Twenty-four pools: HumanEval+ and MBPP+ ( Liu et al.,, 2023 ) and LiveCodeBench tasks, solutions from Llama-3-8B, Llama-3-70B, GPT-3.5-turbo and GPT-4o-mini, and unit tests generated by CodeRM-8B or Llama-3.1-70B. blocks.en: The paired audit’s settings were chosen among 26 configurations of stratified betting audits (3 paired, 23 per-row) on the Weaver development halves, by the lowest mean ratio of generated answers to the per-pool cheapest competitor at K = 256 K=256 and 1024, and then frozen: α S = 0.95 ​ δ \alpha_{S}=0.95\,\delta , bet cap λ max = 0.95 \lambda_{\max}=0.95 , one pseudo-pair, the bet ε / ( ε + v ^ ) \varepsilon/(\varepsilon+\hat{v}) , and 0.05 ​ δ 0.05\,\delta for the final exact-binomial look. Evaluation ran five independent audits per pool and horizon at ε = 1 / 32 \varepsilon=1/32 and δ = 0.05 \delta=0.05 . During development, provisional evaluation runs of an earlier configuration were launched and one completed; its output was set aside unread until the final method had been fixed and evaluated. The per-pool minimum over three competing designs is an optimistic denominator. The rank-based audit’s calibration size of 1,200 paths was chosen after its outcomes on the Weaver pools were known, the nested design uses the fixed look ratio 1.25, and the exact-binomial designs have no tuning parameter.

blocks.en: G.3 Competing certified audits

blocks.en: All competitors meet the same requirement: half-width ε \varepsilon at every budget with simultaneous coverage 1 − δ 1-\delta for every answer law. The four designs in the first three items draw questions uniformly at random. • Exact binomial with completion. A predetermined number of paths is sized so that an exact-binomial interval has half-width at most ε \varepsilon at every possible count. For each budget in turn, paths are revealed in order until the set of intervals consistent with every value of the unrevealed paths has width at most 2 ​ ε 2\varepsilon . • Nested exact binomial. Looks grow geometrically by a factor 1.25 1.25 , the error is split over budget–look pairs in advance, each new path is generated only up to the largest unresolved budget, and a budget retires when its interval is narrow enough. The last look resolves every budget. • Rank-based stopping. Complete calibration paths (1,200 of them) learn a score threshold above which a correct incumbent can be frozen; a distribution-free rank bound limits later threshold exceedances, and a widened exact-binomial interval covers the stopped paths. A nested version adds early looks with error spending. • Fixed designs. Every question receives the same number of full paths, with a Hoeffding or an exact-binomial interval and a union over budgets. These designs are balanced but cannot see the within-question variance. • Record design ( Fitas,, 2026 ) . Independent full paths with labels at score records and simultaneous bands, sized for the same ( ε , δ ) (\varepsilon,\delta) . Table 4 lists every design on the held-out pools. The first three form the prespecified comparator of Table 2 ; at K = 64 K=64 and 256 the cheapest of all six is the cheapest of those three on every held-out pool.

blocks.zh: G.4 缺额

blocks.en: All arms run on the stored pools with the random-number streams of the main study (the balanced exact-binomial arm draws its extra balanced rounds after them), and the paired and per-row costs of every held-out run are reproduced exactly. Balanced exact binomial runs the nested exact-binomial looks on balanced rounds, each look rounded up to a whole round and each tail inverted at the corrected level of Lemma 8 . Per-row betting is a stratified confidence sequence that centers each question’s outcome at its running mean with a quarter pseudo-count, estimates the variance from the running squared residuals, bets min ⁡ { 0.6 , ε / σ ^ 2 } \min\{0.6,\varepsilon/\hat{\sigma}^{2}\} and checks after every round; its settings were frozen during development. A matched version uses the paired audit’s bet ε / ( ε + σ ^ 2 ) \varepsilon/(\varepsilon+\hat{\sigma}^{2}) and cap 0.95 0.95 . Table 5 gives the medians.

blocks.en: G.5 The all-subsets audit
blocks.zh: G.5 联合国 所有子集审计

blocks.en: The implementation uses bet cap 0.9 0.9 , a prior of one pseudo-row for the predictions c x , k c_{x,k} , a first round with zero bet that only sets the predictions, and the error split 0.95 ​ δ 0.95\,\delta for the sequence and 0.05 ​ δ 0.05\,\delta for a fixed-round exact-binomial look on the binary outcome of each full path, inverted at the corrected level of Lemma 8 . Its unbiasedness requires the answers within a path to be independent given the question.
G.6 The cost law
blocks.zh: G.6 联合国 成本法

blocks.en: The law across settings is fitted to the five-run mean costs at ε = 1 / 32 \varepsilon=1/32 and K ∈ { 64,256 , 1024 } K\in\{64,256,1024\} and the two-run mean costs at K = 64 K=64 and ε ∈ { 1 / 16 , 1 / 64 } \varepsilon\in\{1/16,1/64\} , with Σ w \Sigma_{\mathrm{w}} computed exactly from each pool; its 90th-percentile relative error is 12.0%. The law used for the MMLU-Pro prediction was fitted earlier, to two paired audits per pool at K = 64 K=64 and ε = 1 / 32 \varepsilon=1/32 on all 217 pools, run with bet cap 0.6 0.6 . It was fitted before any answer of the study, pilot answers included, was generated. The paired audits of the MMLU-Pro study used cap 0.6 0.6 as well. Replaying the three stored audit streams at caps 0.6 0.6 and 0.95 0.95 gives identical best-of- k k costs (78,800, 80,400 and 78,200 answers), because the bet ε / ( ε + v ^ ) \varepsilon/(\varepsilon+\hat{v}) never exceeded 0.58; for pass@ k k and majority voting the lower cap binds on 66 to 143 of about 290 bets and moves the cost by a few percent in either direction.
blocks.zh: 跨设置的法律适用于5运行的平均成本 = 1/ 32\ varepsilon=1/32和K { 64,256, 1024} K\in = 64, 256, 1024\ 和双运行的平均成本 = 64 K = 64 K = 64 和 { { { { 1 / 16, 1/ 64}\ varepsilon\ = 1/16, 1/64\ , 其90 百分点相对误差为 12.0% 。 用于MMLU-Pro预测的法则在较早时就被安装在K = 64 K = 64和Q = 1 / 32\ varepsilon =1/32的所有217个游泳池上,每个游泳池进行两次对联审计,运行时使用注上限0.6 0.6。 在研究得到任何答复(包括试点答复)之前就安装了这个系统。 MMLU-Pro研究的配对审计也使用了0.6上限。 以0.6和0.95 0.95的上限重播存储的三种审计流,给出了相同的最佳kk成本(78,800,80,400和78,200个答案),因为下注Q / (+ + ^ )\varepsilon/ (\varepsilon +\hat{v})从未超过0.58;因为通过@ k k 和多数人投票,下注在大约290个赌注中的66至143个上,将成本向两个方向移动5%。

blocks.en: G.7 The MMLU-Pro study
blocks.zh: G.7 MMLU-Pro研究

blocks.en: The protocol was written before any evaluation answer was generated. It fixed a subset of 100 MMLU-Pro questions from mathematics, physics, chemistry and engineering, with 50 further questions for pilots; the model gpt-6-luna (the interface reports no dated version; answers were generated on 27–28 September 2026) at temperature 1, without reasoning effort, with token log-probabilities, at most 400 completion tokens and eight answers per request; a prompt asking for a brief reason followed by a final line “Answer: X”; the verifier score, which is the mean token log-probability of a response with a valid extracted letter, invalid responses receiving the lowest score; correctness, which is agreement of the extracted letter with the published answer key; three audit streams consumed in generation order with common random numbers across audits; a separate reference stream; and the comparison designs.
blocks.zh: 协议是在产生任何评价答复之前编写的。 它从数学、物理、化学和工程学中确定了100个MMLU-Pro问题的子集,对飞行员提出了50个其他问题;gpt-6-luna模型(接口报告没有日期;答复是在2026年9月27日至28日在1温度下生成的,没有推理努力,每个请求至少有400个完成符号和8个答复;迅速询问一个简短的理由,然后是最后一行 " Answer: X " ;核查者得分,这是用有效提取的字母答复的平均符号日志概率,得到最低分数的无效答复;正确性,即提取的字母与公布的答案键一致;三个审计流按生成顺序消耗,整个审计中共有随机数字;一个单独的参考流;以及比较设计。

blocks.en: Audit streams were generated through the batch interface, and part of the reference stream through the flexible-priority interface with the same parameters. Answers from different generation windows agree: across the 100 questions, single-answer accuracy in the audit streams differs from the reference stream by 0.0022 on average (paired t = 1.30 t=1.30 ). Answers within a request behave as independent draws: given the stream and the question, the intraclass correlation of correctness among the eight answers of a request is 0.005. Of the 716,384 answers, 5.2% had no valid letter and 12 were truncated.
blocks.zh: 审计流程是通过批量接口生成的,部分参考流程是通过具有相同参数的灵活优先界面生成的. 来自不同世代窗口的答案一致:在100个问题中,审计流程的单答准确度与参考流平均差0.0022(paired t = 1.30 t = 1.30). 请求中的答复表现为独立绘图:鉴于流和问题,请求的8个答复中正确性之间的阶级内关联是0.005。 在716 384份答复中,5.2%没有有效信件,12份被截断。

blocks.en: Reference curves come from the 409,448 reference answers: exact finite-sample formulas for best-of- k k and pass@ k k , and an exact multinomial computation for majority voting. The all-subsets audits for pass@ k k and majority voting stopped at the same round in each stream (8, 8 and 7), and their paths were never shortened, so their costs equal the number of rounds times 100 × 64 100\times 64 .
blocks.zh: 参考曲线来自409,448个参考答案:精确的有限-样本公式用于最优Kk和通过@kk,精确的多数表决的多名计算. 对通过@ k k 和多数投票的全子集审核在每个流(8,8和7)的同一轮停止,其路径从未缩短,因此其成本等于轮数乘以100×64100\时64.

blocks.en: G.8 Computation
blocks.zh: G.8 计算

blocks.en: Prefix winners along a generated path are updated in time linear in its length. Updating the active budgets after a pair of rounds takes O ⁡ ( M ​ K ) O(MK) operations, so a paired audit of R R rounds runs in O ⁡ ( N + R ​ M ​ K ) O(N+RMK) time with O ⁡ ( M ​ K ) O(MK) working memory.
